newsitem.title: GERMANY: German government raises yield on 5-yr Bobls.
newsitem.headline: German government raises yield on 5-yr Bobls.

text.p: The German government is raising the yield on its five-year Bundesobligationen tap-issue bonds by lowering the issue price of the paper to 99.50.
The move, effective on immediately, brings the yield on the Series 120 paper to 5.11 percent from 5.05 percent.
The yield on five-year bonds was last changed on Aug 29, when it was lowered 5.05 percent from 5.12 percent. --Frankfurt Newsroom 49 69 7567525
